{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check: now we should have 800 rows (one per patient)
print(f"After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} rows")
print(f"Unique patient_id after dedup: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check response rate by arm after deduplication
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print(f"Response rate by arm after deduplication:\n{response_rates}")

# Compute treatment effect: treatment - control
treatment_rate = response_rates['treatment']
control_rate = response_rates['control']
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

print(f"Treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect}")"}
